docs.title: Content
docs.text:
Provided datasets of 5 bacterial contaminated human samples. Datasets contained paired Illumina and Nanopore reads. Samples A,B,D,E datasets contained Illumina and corresponding Nanopore Sample C's dataset contained only paired Illumina reads.

Assemblies were generated using SPAdes and SPAdes hybrid.
